While the run is Running the cycle receives its packets on the group and port bldcas serves for HPSEX (loopback) with their source and gets every PV its source (PVCtrls) defines; coverage counts it RUN when 10 or more packets came from the socket of the pid its procmgr log gives, each event at simxpm's pulse ID for its time within the run's L1Accepts, the packets' ID and each event's valid word the FIELDMASK it served, and PAYLOAD's type ID that mask (hps_problem)

prog:hpsBldCopy.note: daq_sim up --hps + cycle (R9): procmgr runs lab3-bld.cnf's hpsBldCopy -i eno2 -I DAQ:LAB2:HPSEX -O DAQ:LAB2:<cp> -o 0 as hpsBldCopy -i lo -I DAQ:SIM:HPSEX -O DAQ:SIM:HPSCPA -o 0 on hpsBldServer's packets (prog:hpsBldServer: its crate the stand-in psdaq.sim.simhps), input PAYLOAD from hpsBldServer and groups from bldcas. Since c41b8a44b HpsEventIterator left the packets' ID 0, so it dropped every packet ('id changed 0x8000 -> 0x0'); this branch restores the ID (the channel mask, PAYLOAD's type ID), base vs head in RUNBOOK 3d. While the run is Running the cycle receives its packets on the group and port bldcas serves for HPSCPA (loopback) with their source; coverage counts it RUN when 10 or more came from the socket of the pid its procmgr log gives, each event's valid word the FIELDMASK hpsBldServer served, carrying the times of hpsBldServer's events (as its Client gives the pulse ID), within the run's L1Accepts (hps_problem)
